import math

# FD-1 Summary of Federal Debt, Sept 2000 bulletin
# Held by government accounts and held by the public, end of fiscal year, in millions of dollars
# Standard FD-1 values for fiscal years 1995-1999 (Federal debt, in millions)

# Public debt securities held by U.S. Government accounts (government holdings), $ millions
gov = {
    1995: 1316208,
    1996: 1447392,
    1997: 1596862,
    1998: 1757090,
    1999: 1973160,
}

# Public debt securities held by the public, $ millions
public = {
    1995: 3603378,
    1996: 3733003,
    1997: 3778331,
    1998: 3733425,
    1999: 3636104,
}

years = [1995, 1996, 1997, 1998, 1999]

def coeff_var_log_growth(series):
    # year-to-year log growth rates
    growths = []
    for i in range(1, len(years)):
        growths.append(math.log(series[years[i]] / series[years[i-1]]))
    n = len(growths)
    mean = sum(growths) / n
    # population standard deviation
    var = sum((g - mean) ** 2 for g in growths) / n
    sd = math.sqrt(var)
    return sd / abs(mean)

cv_gov = coeff_var_log_growth(gov)
cv_public = coeff_var_log_growth(public)

diff = abs(cv_gov - cv_public)
print(round(diff, 3))
